name: restore_project
description: Restore a soft-deleted ChatCut project (undo delete_project or a dashboard delete) for the signed-in owner. The project reappears in the dashboard and list_projects. Discover deleted projects with list_projects includeDeleted=true.

editorBaseUrl.description: Editor origin/base URL. Defaults to CHATCUT_EDITOR_URL or http://localhost:5173.

projectId.description: Full UUID or unique 10-hex ID of the soft-deleted project.
